description_en: Creates a mapping between an entity and a benefit package. This operation lets you assign a benefit package to a user
description_zh: 创建实体和权益包关联，可用于给用户绑定权益包
name: CreateIdentityToBenefitPkgMapping

parameters.help_en:
The quantity of the benefit package.

This parameter applies only to resource-type benefit packages. It is optional and defaults to 1
parameters.help_zh:
权益包数量

对资源类权益包生效，非必填参数，默认为1
parameters.name: amount

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier for the benefit package
parameters.name: benefit_pkg_id

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of the benefit package. This is a Unix timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 on January 1, 1970, UTC.

If this parameter is not specified, the benefit package never expires
parameters.help_zh:
权益包超期时间的时间戳，格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒起至现在的毫秒数

默认永不过期
parameters.name: expire_time

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier for the entity.

To manage benefits for a user, provide the user ID
parameters.help_zh:
实体的唯一标识

管理用户权益时，传user_id
parameters.name: identity_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the entity.

To manage benefits for a user, set this parameter to `user`
parameters.help_zh:
实体的类型

管理用户权益时，传user
parameters.name: identity_type
